business_summary: ShiFang Holding Limited, an investment holding company, operates in the publishing and advertising businesses in the People's Republic of China. It operates through Publishing and Advertising, and Tourism and Integrated Development segments. The company offers newspaper advertising services; value-added advertising services; digital publishing services; and tailor-made digital advertising services, such as the content draft, design, and production. It also provides TV advertising services for real estate and automotive clients, as well as designs and produces mini-programs and related advertisements for automotive industry. In addition, it offers integrated printed media services to advertising customers in various industries; various other services, including distribution management, publishing printed content by digital means, as well as market promotion values; printing and distribution consultancy services; publication distribution consultation and management services; and newspaper printing services. Further, the company provides integrated marketing services for web products, computer software development and sales, and technical services; corporate management information consultancy; marketing, agent, and economic information consultancy for the real estate industry; property management; advertising services; human resources; and technology promotion and consultancy services. Additionally, it involved in the tourism and entertainment business; and mobile media services. The company serves the consumer products, real estate, computer and communication, telecommunications, home appliance retailing, automotive, home construction materials, healthcare and medical, education, and classified advertisement sectors. ShiFang Holding Limited was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Fuzhou, the People's Republic of China.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 ShiFang Holding Limited는 중화인민공화국에서 출판 및 광고 사업을 운영하고 있습니다. 출판 및 광고, 관광 및 통합 개발 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 회사는 신문 광고 서비스를 제공합니다. 부가 가치 광고 서비스; 디지털 출판 서비스; 콘텐츠 초안, 디자인, 제작 등 맞춤형 디지털 광고 서비스를 제공합니다. 또한 부동산 및 자동차 고객을 위한 TV 광고 서비스를 제공할 뿐만 아니라 자동차 산업을 위한 미니 프로그램 및 관련 광고를 디자인 및 제작합니다. 또한 다양한 산업 분야의 광고 고객에게 통합 인쇄 미디어 서비스를 제공합니다. 유통 관리, 디지털 방식으로 인쇄된 콘텐츠 출판, 시장 홍보 가치를 포함한 다양한 기타 서비스; 인쇄 및 유통 컨설팅 서비스; 출판물 유통 상담 및 관리 서비스; 신문 인쇄 서비스도 제공됩니다. 또한 회사는 웹 제품, 컴퓨터 소프트웨어 개발 및 판매, 기술 서비스에 대한 통합 마케팅 서비스를 제공합니다. 기업경영정보콘
